description: This is a test class for the SetupSupport utility in the AnySoftKeyboard project, containing unit tests for various setup and configuration methods, including locale handling, keyboard enablement, animation, and preferences.

classes.name: SetupSupportTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SetupSupport utility functions in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets default locale and application context.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets locale to default after tests.

methods.name: testIsThisKeyboardSetAsDefaultIME_before34
methods.description: Tests whether the keyboard is set as default IME before Android 34, using Robolectric environment.

methods.name: testIsThisKeyboardEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard is enabled in the application context.

methods.name: testHasLanguagePackForCurrentLocale
methods.description: Verifies language pack availability for current locale, including mock responses and locale changes.

methods.name: testPopupAnimation
methods.description: Tests the popup view animation method for two views, verifying start offsets.

methods.name: testPopupViewAnimationWithIds
methods.description: Tests animated popup of views identified by resource IDs within a root view.

methods.name: testKeyboardZoomFactorPortrait
methods.description: Verifies keyboard height scaling factor in portrait orientation, considering preferences.

methods.name: testKeyboardZoomFactorLandscape
methods.description: Verifies keyboard height scaling factor in landscape orientation, considering preferences.
